tests.fail_or_repair: Treat human review as theater and pause higher-risk use until reviewers have time, source access, authority, and feedback channels.
tests.label: meaningful human review quality gate
tests.question: Is human review specific enough to catch false, incomplete, biased, out-of-scope, or overconfident AI outputs before public action?

tests.fail_or_repair: Disable public-action use of outputs until source lineage is preserved and reviewable.
tests.label: input / source / case-file lineage
tests.question: Can reviewers reconstruct which documents, letters, policies, scanned images, briefing packs, or case files shaped the output?

tests.fail_or_repair: Require change-control and audit records before relying on tool outputs across time or across departments.
tests.label: model, supplier, admin, and change record
tests.question: Can the agency show which model, supplier, hosting route, prompt, retrieval method, and admin-support path shaped output at the time of use?

activated_by: generating inspection or risk report sections
tests.fail_or_repair: Require an output-capture policy before generated text or fields can become official correspondence, case records, reports, or queue triggers.
tests.label: output / draft / field record capture
tests.question: Are drafts, summaries, extracted fields, labels, reports, edits, final outputs, and model / prompt versions captured when the output reaches official action?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat performance claims as incomplete until errors feed into retraining, tuning, process repair, user notice, or suspension.
tests.label: performance, bias, error, and feedback loop
tests.question: Do staff corrections, citizen corrections, false positives, false negatives, topic errors, subgroup risks, and incident reports change the system or governance route?

tests.fail_or_repair: Prevent AI-shaped correspondence or guidance from being sent until source support, QA, and correction routes are documented.
tests.label: public communication release gate
tests.question: Before AI-shaped text leaves the agency, is there a release gate linking sources, human edits, final wording, and correction route?

tests.fail_or_repair: Freeze expansion or downshift to personal productivity until owner, task, and prohibited-use records are explicit.
tests.label: public owner and task boundary
pass_evidence: named public owner and service owner
approved task list and forbidden uses
pilot / production status and expansion approval
public-action boundary between draft, route, record, and decision
tests.question: Can the agency identify the public owner, service owner, task, users, public-action boundary, and prohibited uses for the staff-facing AI system?

tests.fail_or_repair: Separate clerical acceleration from public service effect; add queue audits and fallback channels for missed cases.
tests.label: queue, priority, and service-speed effect
tests.question: Does the system change allocation, queue, urgency, support routing, response speed, inspection scope, or case readiness before full human review?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat secure hosting as substantive accuracy proof; add data-boundary and support-access records.
tests.label: sensitive-data and privilege boundary
tests.question: Are official-sensitive material, personal data, vulnerable-person data, legal privilege, safeguarding information, and admin access governed separately from output reliability?

tests.fail_or_repair: Create per-use-case review before allowing outputs to enter public records, correspondence, reports, queues, or decisions.
tests.label: use-case register and prohibited-use gate
pass_evidence: separate approval for correspondence, intake, triage, report drafting, policy advice, or case summaries
tests.question: Does each practical use case have a scope gate rather than relying on one platform-level approval?

use_rule: Run staff-copilot tests whenever an internal AI tool used by officials drafts, summarizes, classifies, routes, creates case records, flags vulnerability, prepopulates fields, writes report sections, or otherwise shapes public action without speaking directly to the public. Separate personal productivity from official record creation, record creation from queue or priority effect, and staff assistance from legal or similarly significant decisions.
